name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted LLM chat frontend for roleplay and character chats that connects to OpenAI, Claude, Ollama, KoboldCpp and many other text and image APIs.

alerts.message: The site is protected by HTTP basic authentication: sign in with the SILLYTAVERN_USERNAME and SILLYTAVERN_PASSWORD values from the environment settings.
SillyTavern ships no language model. Connect it to an external or self-hosted LLM API and enter its key in the API Connections panel.
